niche.title: Training efficiency of tiny character-level Transformers
niche.description: Which architecture and optimization choices change the validation loss of a very small character-level Transformer language model trained for a short, fixed number of steps? We care about normalization, activation functions, positional encoding, optimizers, learning-rate schedules and regularization, as reported for Transformer language models.

coverage_rule:
Our setting: transformer, char_language_modeling, tiny, step-budgeted training.
covers: model_family ∈ {transformer, general} AND task ∈ {char_language_modeling, language_modeling, general} AND scale ∈ {tiny, small}.
partially covers: same model_family and task condition AND scale ∈ {medium, large, unspecified}.
does not cover: anything else.
For overlap / prior art, covers OR partially covers counts as covered (we avoid rediscovery). For evidence relations (agrees / contradicts), only covers counts.
Curated (T1) claims carry a human covers / does-not-cover flag instead of extracted fields.
